Paragraph: "Then the ministers of Sugreeva, assembled on that best mountain and gathered around the chief of monkeys Sugreeva, and all stood with their adjoined palms..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Transitioning from chaotic flight to structured, respectful council.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: The ministers assemble, show respect with adjoined palms, and wait for order.
Outcome/Resolution: Physical containment and formal hierarchy are re-established.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Pranjali (Gesture of respect, focus, and mental submission)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Reconnecting with reverent alignment (Pranjali) brings order back to a mind shaken by chaos.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Structured grounding: using formal protocol and physical alignment to restore cognitive focus during crisis.
